independence_declaration.statement: qa-verifier authored no product implementation in the DG2 scope. Its only authored files are QA tests, harnesses and evidence (tests/qa/**, e2e/**, docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/qa/**). The round-9 repairs are by other roles: D-069 declared request media types (T-DG2-BE14, backend-workflow-engineer) and the one-alert-per-form-error fix (e3cadfa, T-DG2-FE8, frontend-ux-engineer). Every result here comes from qa-verifier's own runs in disposable clones of 7854770e under $TMPDIR, removed afterwards. At the start the candidate tree's HEAD was 041478cb (the round-9 freeze: assignments, manifest and stages.json only). The recomputed candidate ID matched in the tree, at --ref 7854770e and in the clone. During the run HEAD moved to db8caee (domain-reviewer's and code-security-reviewer's auto-committed round-9 evidence). qa-verifier did not open those files, and at the end the ID was still 45ebccc0… with 544 files. The verdict was formed without reading any other reviewer's round-9 record.

checks_run.procedure: Verify the frozen candidate. Recompute the candidate ID in the candidate tree (at the start and the end), at --ref 7854770e, and in a disposable clone checked out at the source commit. Confirm the source commit is an ancestor of HEAD and that the commits between them change only delivery metadata.
checks_run.command: git rev-parse HEAD; git merge-base --is-ancestor 7854770e HEAD; git diff --stat 7854770e HEAD; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG2; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG2 --ref 7854770e; (clone) node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG2
checks_run.environment: candidate tree HEAD 041478cb (start) / db8caee (end); clone $TMPDIR/review-dg2 @7854770e; node v24.21.0
checks_run.actual: Every computation gives sha256:45ebccc04d8efc0c4fdc6a842eb3c9ec330bab2ec517b1c592af60b05a066294 with 544 files. 041478cb adds only the round-9 assignments, the manifest and stages.json. At the end HEAD was db8caee (other reviewers' evidence commits) and the ID was unchanged.

checks_run.procedure: R9-01 (raw socket, real stack). Send uploadEvidenceContent in 9 undeclared media types: text/plain with invalid bytes, text/plain;charset=utf-8, JSON object, JSON string, multipart/form-data, x-www-form-urlencoded, image/png, application/octet-streams, and no Content-Type with a body. Use Content-Length and chunked framing, with a session, and once without a session. Check audit_event by request id (psql on the real DB), evidence_content rows, the evidence version and currentContentId, the download, and the stored files.
checks_run.command: npx playwright test e2e/dg2-qa-r9.spec.ts -g R9-01 (within QA-R9-16/17/18)
checks_run.environment: as QA-R9-16; chromium-en and chromium-ar projects; both locale settings
checks_run.expected: every request 400 problem+json validation.content_type at pointer ""; 0 audit rows; nothing stored
checks_run.actual: 18/18 per project and run: 400 validation.content_type at "" with requestId = X-Request-Id and 0 audit rows each. Without a session: 400 as well (documented D-069 order: parsing before authentication). Evidence version 1→1, currentContentId null, download 404, 0 evidence_content rows, 0 stored files.

checks_run.procedure: R9-02 (raw socket). Upload 3 revisions of binary content: all 256 byte values, invalid-UTF-8 sequences and 64 KiB pseudo-random bytes with Content-Length; a chunked revision split mid-buffer; and one with 'Application/Octet-Stream; charset=binary'. Use an Arabic/emoji percent-encoded X-File-Name. Download each revision and compare bytes, sha256, the Digest header and the DB sha256/size. Check that each upload has an audit row.
checks_run.command: npx playwright test e2e/dg2-qa-r9.spec.ts -g R9-02 (within QA-R9-16/17/18)
checks_run.expected: 200 for each; downloaded bytes identical; sha256 = DB = Digest; ≥1 audit row; file name round-trips
checks_run.actual: All 3 revisions return 200 (65804, 20268 and 3256 bytes). Downloads are byte-identical; sha256 equals the DB value and the Digest header; 1 audit row each. The file name round-trips (Content-Disposition attachment with filename*=UTF-8''…). Same result in en and ar, in both locale settings.

checks_run.procedure: R9-03/R9-06 (raw socket). Send PATCH charter in text/plain, text/plain;charset, octet-stream, form-urlencoded, text/json, application/jsonp and with no Content-Type, x 2 framings. Send POST transformations in text/plain and octet-stream. Send logout (a bodiless operation) with a text/plain body. Send JSON declared with charset iso-8859-1 or utf-16 but with non-UTF-8 bytes. Positive controls: 'application/json; charset=UTF-8' and 'APPLICATION/JSON'.
checks_run.expected: 400 validation.content_type and nothing written for the undeclared types; logout refused and the session kept; non-UTF-8 JSON is a 4xx, never a 5xx, with nothing written; the declared JSON variants are accepted
checks_run.actual: 16/16 refused with 400 validation.content_type and no audit row. Charter version 1→1 with its value unchanged; 0 transformations created. Logout with text/plain: 400 content_type, and GET /me is still 200. iso-8859-1 E9 and utf-16 bodies: 400 validation.json, no audit row, nothing created. charset=UTF-8 → 200, APPLICATION/JSON chunked → 200, charset=utf-8 POST → 201.

F-DG2-340 is CLOSED_VERIFIED: the form-level message is said once in EN-LTR and AR-RTL on the charter, transformation create, organization create and ReasonDialog; a distinct second message is kept; field errors stay on their fields.
